report.title: BioMar Group Q3 2026 Report - Strong volume growth and exceptional earnings
results: Despite higher fixed costs, EBIT for the first nine months of the year amounted to DKK 977m, compared with DKK 785m in the corresponding period last year.
Profit & loss Revenue increased by 19% to DKK 5,807m in Q3 2026 from DKK 4,898m in Q3 2025, driven by higher volumes and increasing raw material prices, particularly marine fish oil and fish meal.

Revenue for the first nine months of 2026 increased by 7% to DKK 13,172m from DKK 12,270m year to date in Q3 2025, primarily reflecting higher volumes, raw material prices and product and customer mix.
Other costs and other operating income and expenses increased year on year in Q3 2026 from DKK 352m to DKK 432m.
For the first nine months of 2026, other costs and other operating income and expenses increased year on year from DKK 929m to DKK 1,121m, reflecting the same matters as above.

outlook.text: Supported by the volume outlook, higher raw material prices and current exchange rates, BioMar raises its 2026 revenue guidance to DKK 17.8-18.6 billion range from previously DKK 17.0-18.0 billion.

Based on strong earnings momentum in the first nine months of 2026, but a lower volume guidance for 2026, increasing prices on ingredients, and uncertainties particularly related to Ecuador, BioMar is upgrading its EBIT guidance to DKK 1,290-1,360 million range from previously DKK 1,200-1,300 million.
